name: sermon-slide-builder
description: Build faithful, image-rich sermon PowerPoints from pastor-provided notes and templates.

interface.shortDescription: Turn sermon notes into faithful PowerPoint decks.
interface.longDescription: Sermon Slide Builder helps ChatGPT and Codex create editable sermon PowerPoints, source or generate appropriate visuals, preserve the pastor's wording and theology, and audit the finished deck against the notes.
defaultPrompt: Build a sermon PowerPoint from my notes.
Create consistent biblical images and build my sermon PowerPoint.
Audit this sermon deck against my notes.
